exercise.explanation: Thứ tự đúng: Coral reefs around the world are experiencing increasingly frequent bleaching events. Repeated bleaching events over short periods of time can ultimately lead to the complete death of a reef system. Limiting global temperature rise remains the most effective long-term strategy for protecting coral reef ecosystems.
